metadata.benchmark.Contract: Deterministic synthetic ZIP, pinned Apple fixture, or OfficeIMO-created native Keynote package: load/project, load/convert/save, or native encoding/save. I/O cancellation requests follow package-read or native-copy I/O. Opt-in phase cancellation uses a preloaded source projection or native encoding before caller writes, with timed requests and active process CPU observations. Input/model preparation and full semantic recovery are outside timing. Owned native creation is not independent Apple or appearance qualification.
metadata.benchmark.PhaseCancellation: 25 ms timer after entering the operation harness; require at least 20 ms elapsed and 5 ms process CPU advancement before request, untouched caller output and complete source recovery. CPU includes observer/host work and scheduling does not locate an internal parser/encoder checkpoint. Timer-dependent cases are opt-in and are not ordinary correctness gates.
metadata.benchmark.NativeNumbersPolicy: Pinned simple.numbers requires editable output and all nine typed cells. Explicit partial policy accepts only IWORK_NUMBERS_CELL_PADDING_OMITTED and its partial-policy marker; automatic-decimal and border-width approximations remain reported. Unresolved selected units, references, declarations or cells, and other loss diagnostics fail validation.
metadata.benchmark.Measurement: PowerForge elapsed time and managed allocation including host invocation. Working-set deltas are not peak or retained memory. Saving uses normal owner APIs.
metadata.benchmark.RetainedMemory: Opt-in collected process-wide managed heap before execution and after validation/result release. Includes host/cache effects; excludes native and peak memory.
metadata.benchmark.SampledMemory: Opt-in PowerForge managed-heap/resident observations during operations. Maxima are observed lower bounds, include observer/host effects and do not isolate native allocations. Instrumented timing uses a separate run mode.
metadata.benchmark.AffinityPolicy: Inherited; macOS processor placement is unqualified. Keep competing work idle and record host power mode.

nativeLargeProjection.scope: Timed cancellation of a loaded 512-slide source saved by Apple Keynote 15.4; two repeated native text layouts, independent source profile already qualified.
nativeLargeProjection.protocol: Same 25 ms timer, minimum 20 ms elapsed/5 ms process CPU and joined callback as the owned phase runs; preloaded source, full recovery and source hash checks outside measurement.
nativeLargeProjection.recovery: Every slide: ordered native record identity, text drawables, presenter notes, visible state, frame geometry, zero rotation and opaque background. Selected profile only; opaque auxiliary records are not fully assessed.
nativeLargeProjection.outputIntegrity: Sentinel stream remains writable with its original byte, position and length; source package content hash unchanged. This projection-only operation does not construct a destination document.

host.hardware: Mac16,10; Apple M4; 10 physical/logical processors, 4 performance and 6 efficiency cores
host.contention: Unrelated Swift builds were present in the pre-run command-name snapshot; no task-owned builds ran concurrently. No idle-host claim.

negativeProbes.unsupportedRuntimeProfiles: Apple native encoding rejected before preparation and after valid projection preparation; small Apple, synthetic Keynote and Pages profiles rejected.
negativeProbes.repeatedRecovery: Two consecutive Validate calls after one cancellation each recover 512 units and retain exactly one cancellation boundary.
negativeProbes.wrapper: Both PowerShell sources parse; NativeLarge encoding-only, encoding/projection mixture and ordinary/phase mixtures reject before loading binaries. Plan selects exactly one NativeLarge Keynote projection case.

nativeLargeProjection.review: No additional full review: this extension reuses the independently reviewed phase timer/lifetime and full native validation owners. Profile selection, wrapper guard and repeated counter reset received direct focused checks; no production API or runtime dependency changed.
limits: Two repeated native layouts do not qualify varied independent-producer workloads or other formats.
Process-wide CPU includes host and observer work; timer scheduling does not locate an internal checkpoint.
Destination construction, atomic path staging and broader native encoding remain unqualified.
Contended observations do not establish portable latency, allocation or peak/native-memory budgets.
No additional Apple application, sandbox or physical-device acceptance is implied by this cancellation run.
